_comment: Editorial metadata for the D3 graph. Keyed by content-relative target (a topic-folder, or a single .md page). `id`, `title`, and the math/code/intuition ratings and `failure` line are editorial and live here; `path`, `group` and all `links` are DERIVED from the content tree by corpus/tools/build_visualizer.py -- do not hand-edit those in visualizer.html.

foundations/bayesian-statistics.title: Bayesian Statistics
foundations/bayesian-statistics.failure: Prior misspecification dominating with little data; MCMC chains that never mix.

foundations/calculus-and-optimization.title: Calculus & Optimization
foundations/calculus-and-optimization.failure: Non-convex constraint trapping, ill-conditioned Hessian curvature.

foundations/econometrics-and-timeseries.title: Econometrics & Time Series
foundations/econometrics-and-timeseries.failure: Spurious regression on unit-root prices, cointegration breakdown.

foundations/ergodicity-and-statistical-m.title: Ergodicity & Statistical Mechanics
foundations/ergodicity-and-statistical-m.failure: Confusing ensemble averages with single-path multiplicative compounding (ruin).

foundations/linear-algebra-and-matrices.title: Linear Algebra & Matrices
foundations/linear-algebra-and-matrices.failure: Singular covariance matrices, negative eigenvalues in optimizers.

foundations/numerical-methods.title: Numerical Methods
foundations/numerical-methods.failure: Discretization/truncation error unquantified; unstable explicit schemes (CFL violation).

foundations/probability-and-measure-theo.title: Probability & Measure Theory
foundations/probability-and-measure-theo.failure: Filtration leakage (lookahead bias), measure equivalence violations.

foundations/statistics-and-inference.title: Statistics & Inference
foundations/statistics-and-inference.failure: In-sample estimate overfitting; p-hacking across the best of N strategies.

foundations/stochastic-calculus.title: Stochastic Calculus
foundations/stochastic-calculus.failure: Continuous path assumptions failing during overnight price gaps.

fundamentals-accounting.title: Fundamentals & Accounting (Area Hub)
fundamentals-accounting.failure: Treating price/technical signals as if they float free of the company's economics — fundamentals are the ground truth beneath every value, screen, and factor.

fundamentals-accounting/accounting-quali.title: Accounting Quality & Red Flags
fundamentals-accounting/accounting-quali.failure: Accruals reverse (a difference, not a level), and cash-sales fraud blinds the balance-sheet measures.

fundamentals-accounting/capital-structur.title: Capital Structure & Corporate Finance
fundamentals-accounting/capital-structur.failure: The 'leverage is always good' mistake — leverage amplifies downside; buybacks and EPS accretion are not value creation.

fundamentals-accounting/core-financial-r.title: Core Financial Ratios
fundamentals-accounting/core-financial-r.failure: Accounting games beat every ratio; negative denominators and cross-sectional blindness break the outputs.

fundamentals-accounting/data-sources-and.title: Data Sources & Corporate Data
fundamentals-accounting/data-sources-and.failure: Point-in-time and survivorship bias let a backtest 'know' numbers that did not exist on the decision date.

fundamentals-accounting/equity-valuation.title: Equity Valuation
fundamentals-accounting/equity-valuation.failure: GIGO forecasts and terminal-value dominance (70–80% of value) make the DCF's accuracy really the accuracy of its inputs.

fundamentals-accounting/financial-statem.title: Financial Statements & Accounting
fundamentals-accounting/financial-statem.failure: Cash ≠ earnings: accruals separate them, so a firm can report profit while burning cash — trusting one number without the other is the failure.

fundamentals-accounting/fundamental-anal.title: Fundamental Analysis & Screening
fundamentals-accounting/fundamental-anal.failure: The value trap — cheap because the market expects deterioration — plus silent data-quality corruption breaks every screen.

fundamentals-accounting/quantitative-fun.title: Quantitative Fundamental Investing
fundamentals-accounting/quantitative-fun.failure: Backtests manufacture premiums and factors crowd and decay; accounting games hit the factor at its source.

pillars/01-quantitative-research.title: 1. Quant Research (Alpha Gen)
pillars/01-quantitative-research.failure: Data snooping, alpha decay, backtest overfitting.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/backtes.title: Backtesting Hygiene & Deflated Sharpe
pillars/01-quantitative-research/backtes.failure: Selection bias, multiple testing illusion, lucky random backtests.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/event-s.title: Event Studies & Event-Driven
pillars/01-quantitative-research/event-s.failure: Confounding concurrent events, estimation-window contamination by the event, and thin-sample inference on abnormal returns (CAR).

pillars/01-quantitative-research/factor-.title: Factor Investing & Timing
pillars/01-quantitative-research/factor-.failure: Factor crowding & capacity limits, post-publication decay, data-mined factors.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/feature.title: Feature Engineering & Labeling
pillars/01-quantitative-research/feature.failure: Fixed-time horizon horizon blindness, concurrent event leakage.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/fundame.title: Fundamental Multi-Factor Models
pillars/01-quantitative-research/fundame.failure: Factor crowding, multi-fund correlated unwind liquidations.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/garch-a.title: GARCH & Volatility Modeling
pillars/01-quantitative-research/garch-a.failure: Structural breaks inflate persistence; leverage/asymmetry ignored; high-order models overfit.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/momentu.title: Cross-Sectional & Time-Series Momentum
pillars/01-quantitative-research/momentu.failure: Momentum crash during violent market rebounds; whipsaws in choppy markets.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/regime-.title: Regime Detection
pillars/01-quantitative-research/regime-.failure: Label switching, overfitting the number of regimes, and look-ahead bias from smoothed (full-sample) regime probabilities.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/signal-.title: Signal Processing & Kalman Filter
pillars/01-quantitative-research/signal-.failure: Lagging state estimates, error covariance singularity.

pillars/01-quantitative-research/statist.title: StatArb & Pairs Trading
pillars/01-quantitative-research/statist.failure: Structural break in spread, spread divergence into liquidation.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft.title: 2. Algorithmic Trading & HFT
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft.failure: Adverse selection, stale cancels swept by latency snipers.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/colocation-an.title: Colocation & Clock Synchronization
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/colocation-an.failure: PTP clock skew inflating measured latency; wrong proximity tier in the speed race.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/execution-alg.title: Execution: VWAP, TWAP, & POV
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/execution-alg.failure: Volume smile distortion on news days, deterministic sniping.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/execution-bac.title: Execution Backtesting & Simulation
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/execution-bac.failure: Zero-latency fill fantasy, infinite liquidity at bar close, optimistic impact models.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/hardware-acce.title: Hardware Acceleration & FPGA
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/hardware-acce.failure: Silicon state machine deadlock, inflexible unpatchable logic.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/low-latency-s.title: Low-Latency Systems Architecture
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/low-latency-s.failure: Kernel interrupts, context switches, cacheline false sharing.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/market-micros.title: Market Microstructure & Orders
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/market-micros.failure: Iceberg detection, crossing spreads in swept books.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/optimal-execu.title: Optimal Execution (Almgren-Chriss)
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/optimal-execu.failure: Static volatility assumption, square-root impact breakdown.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/queue-positio.title: Queue Position & Fill Probability
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/queue-positio.failure: Standing queue delusion; filled only when market crashes against you.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/smart-order-r.title: Smart Order Routing & Fragmentation
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/smart-order-r.failure: Stale NBBO, locked/crossed books, and fee-chasing routes into toxic venues.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing.title: 3. Derivative Pricing & Structuring
pillars/03-derivative-pricing.failure: Model risk, unhedged jump risks, surface arbitrage.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/advanced-v.title: Advanced Volatility: Heston & SABR
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/advanced-v.failure: Stochastic-vol parameters drift; model risk dominates parameter risk.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/american-o.title: American Options & Optimal Stopping
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/american-o.failure: Mispriced early-exercise boundary; a truncated lattice skews the optimal-stopping frontier.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/black-scho.title: Black-Scholes-Merton
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/black-scho.failure: Volatility is not constant — the 'riskless' hedging portfolio isn't actually riskless.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/calibratio.title: Calibration & Market Practice
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/calibratio.failure: Overfitting today's smile yields forward dynamics that misprice path-dependents.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/counterpar.title: Counterparty Risk & xVA
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/counterpar.failure: CVA double-counted with funding costs; wrong discounting of collateralised cashflows.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/exotic-and.title: Exotic & Path-Dependent Options
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/exotic-and.failure: Path-dependent payoffs break naive hedges; digital/barrier Greeks spike near the trigger.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/interest-r.title: Interest Rate & Term Structure
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/interest-r.failure: Short-rate calibration that is not arbitrage-free across the full maturity curve.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/no-arbitra.title: No-Arbitrage & Binomial Model
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/no-arbitra.failure: A tree that permits arbitrage or fails to converge to the continuous-time limit.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/numerical-.title: Numerical Methods
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/numerical-.failure: Crank-Nicolson rings at a kink; explicit FDM blows up past the CFL bound.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/options-fu.title: Options, Futures & Markets
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/options-fu.failure: Misreading OTC conventions — payoff, expiry, settlement — before pricing.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/volatility.title: Volatility Surfaces & Smiles
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/volatility.failure: Interpolation arbitrage: smooth fits with negative densities and decreasing total variance.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk.title: 4. Quantitative Risk Management
pillars/04-quantitative-risk.failure: Thin-tail blindness, margin spirals, correlation convergence to 1.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/basel-and-r.title: Basel & Regulation
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/basel-and-r.failure: Capital optimized to the rule rather than the risk; internal-model reliance gamed under sparse loss history.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/copulas-and.title: Copulas & Dependence
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/copulas-and.failure: Correlation assumed constant and linear; the Gaussian copula’s zero tail dependence makes joint crashes invisible.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/counterpart.title: Counterparty Risk & xVA
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/counterpart.failure: Wrong-way risk ignored; CVA booked without credit/funding overlap and unhedged jump-to-default exposure.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/credit-risk.title: Credit Risk & Merton Model
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/credit-risk.failure: Zero short-term default spread flaw, complex debt subordination.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/extreme-val.title: Extreme Value Theory & Fat Tails
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/extreme-val.failure: Threshold bias in POT, assuming i.i.d. extreme shock arrivals.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/liquidity-r.title: Liquidity Risk & Funding
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/liquidity-r.failure: Unilateral haircut hikes, market impact liquidation feedback.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/model-risk-.title: Model Risk & Validation
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/model-risk-.failure: Validation rubber-stamped; recalibration fit to the last crisis window rather than the data-generating process.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/operational.title: Operational Risk
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/operational.failure: Fat right-tail losses undercounted; loss-distribution approaches overfit sparse high-severity history.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/parametric-.title: Parametric, Hist & Monte Carlo VaR
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/parametric-.failure: Non-linear Greeks truncation error, clustered Kupiec breaches.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/risk-factor.title: Risk-Factor Sensitivities
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/risk-factor.failure: Sensitivities assumed regime-stable; delta/gamma blindness to correlation and volatility shifts.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/stress-test.title: Stress Testing & Scenario Analysis
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/stress-test.failure: Correlation breakdown in panics, plausible scenario omission.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/systemic-ri.title: Systemic Risk & Aggregation
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/systemic-ri.failure: Systemic risk is emergent, not additive; aggregating risk types measured in different units/horizons has no correct formula.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/var-and-exp.title: Value at Risk & Expected Shortfall
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/var-and-exp.failure: Subadditivity violation of VaR, extreme tail loss blindness.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization.title: 5. Portfolio Construction & Optimization
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization.failure: Error maximization, extreme unhedged weights, turnover drag.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/black-.title: Black-Litterman Bayesian Allocation
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/black-.failure: Over-confident view matrices degenerating into raw Markowitz.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/constr.title: Constraints & Transaction Costs
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/constr.failure: Assuming linear cost; burning all alpha on rebalance impact.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/covari.title: Covariance Shrinkage & RMT Denoising
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/covari.failure: Over-shrinkage destroying true sector clustering; N > T noise band.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/hierar.title: Hierarchical Risk Parity (HRP)
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/hierar.failure: Sensitivity to tree linkage metric, agnostic to alpha signals.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/kelly-.title: Kelly Criterion & Bet Sizing
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/kelly-.failure: Over-betting on uncertain edge; full Kelly ruins on estimation error, fractional Kelly is the safe deployment.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/modern.title: Mean-Variance Frontiers (Markowitz)
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/modern.failure: Estimation error maximizer; extreme weights from tiny return changes.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/multi-.title: Multi-Asset & Factor Allocation
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/multi-.failure: Asset/factor correlations converge to 1 under stress; factor crowding and regime shifts invalidate static exposures.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/risk-p.title: Risk Parity & ERC
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/risk-p.failure: Leveraged bond drawdown in rising-rate/inflationary shocks.

pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/robust.title: Robust Portfolio Optimization
pillars/05-portfolio-optimization/robust.failure: Over-conservative uncertainty sets eroding expected return; unmodelled parameter drift between fitting and deployment.

pillars/06-market-making.title: 6. Market Making & Liquidity Provision
pillars/06-market-making.failure: Adverse selection bleed, toxic sweep runaway, inventory limit breach.

pillars/06-market-making/adverse-selecti.title: Adverse Selection & Glosten-Milgrom
pillars/06-market-making/adverse-selecti.failure: Quoting tight in high-information assets, toxic flow runaway.

pillars/06-market-making/avellaneda-stoi.title: The Avellaneda-Stoikov Model
pillars/06-market-making/avellaneda-stoi.failure: Terminal horizon inventory dump shock, liquidity density collapse.

pillars/06-market-making/dealer-banks-an.title: Dealer Banks & OTC
pillars/06-market-making/dealer-banks-an.failure: Search frictions, dealer balance-sheet constraints, contagion via dealer networks.

pillars/06-market-making/inventory-manag.title: Inventory Management & Quote Skewing
pillars/06-market-making/inventory-manag.failure: Adverse selection while aggressively skewing, overnight gap risk.

pillars/06-market-making/limit-order-boo.title: LOB Mechanics & Level 3 Data
pillars/06-market-making/limit-order-boo.failure: UDP packet drops desynchronizing book, phantom spoofing orders.

pillars/06-market-making/liquidity-risk-.title: Liquidity Risk & Asset Pricing
pillars/06-market-making/liquidity-risk-.failure: Liquidity beta unstable and crisis-concentrated; illiquidity premium confounded with distress and size effects.

pillars/06-market-making/market-impact-a.title: Market Impact & Depth
pillars/06-market-making/market-impact-a.failure: Square-root law breakdown in thin books; transient impact mistaken for permanent; depth evaporation under stress.

pillars/06-market-making/market-maker-ec.title: Market-Maker Economics & Rebates
pillars/06-market-making/market-maker-ec.failure: Race to zero compresses spreads below cost; rebate-chasing quotes that are adversely selected; PFOF/regulatory shifts.

pillars/06-market-making/spread-decompos.title: Spread Decomposition & Roll Model
pillars/06-market-making/spread-decompos.failure: Positive autocovariance breakdown in strong trending regimes.

pillars/06-market-making/toxic-order-flo.title: Toxic Order Flow & VPIN
pillars/06-market-making/toxic-order-flo.failure: Self-fulfilling liquidity panic as all makers pull quotes simultaneously.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata.title: 7. Machine Learning & Alternative Data
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata.failure: Memorizing noise, regime shift failure, lookahead data leakage.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/alte.title: Alternative Data Pipelines
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/alte.failure: Point-in-time timestamp violation, vendor panel attrition.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/deep.title: Deep Learning for Sequences
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/deep.failure: Massive parameter overfitting on small sample size, high inference latency.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/fina.title: Financial ML Pitfalls & Low SNR
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/fina.failure: Random K-fold CV leakage, test-set overfitting, survivorship bias.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/fina.title: Financial NLP & Transcripts
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/fina.failure: Executive boilerplate tone gaming, static dictionary decay.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/ml-f.title: ML for Portfolio Construction
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/ml-f.failure: Forecast-to-position mismatch, over-fitted ensembling, MVO estimation-error amplification.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/purg.title: Purged CV & Backtest Hygiene
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/purg.failure: Purge/embargo gaps misapplied; combinatorial multiplicity inflates false positives.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/regi.title: Regime Classification (HMM & GMM)
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/regi.failure: State label swapping on retraining, delayed transition detection.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/rein.title: Reinforcement Learning for Trading
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/rein.failure: Reward hacking, non-stationary MDP, unstable policy-gradient training.

pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/tree.title: Tree & Boosting Methods
pillars/07-machine-learning-altdata/tree.failure: MDI importance distortion on high-cardinality noise, collinear cancels.

pillars/08-quantitative-development.title: 8. Quantitative Development
pillars/08-quantitative-development.failure: Race conditions, memory leaks, unhandled exchange drop copies.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/conc.title: Concurrency & Lockless Programming
pillars/08-quantitative-development/conc.failure: Missing memory fences on ARM, ABA problem in lock-free CAS queues.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/data.title: Data Infrastructure & Reproducibility
pillars/08-quantitative-development/data.failure: Point-in-time leakage the checksum cannot see, and unversioned data making a backtest impossible to rebuild.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/even.title: Event-Driven Backtesting Engines
pillars/08-quantitative-development/even.failure: Zero-latency fill fantasy, infinite liquidity at bar close.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/fix-.title: FIX Protocol & Exchange Connectivity
pillars/08-quantitative-development/fix-.failure: Sequence desync lockouts, TCP Nagle buffering delaying packets 40ms.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/high.title: High-Performance C++ for Trading
pillars/08-quantitative-development/high.failure: Dynamic heap allocation in tick callback, branch misprediction stalls.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/low-.title: Low-Latency Linux & Networking
pillars/08-quantitative-development/low-.failure: Kernel interrupts and scheduler preemption inflating the tail; a dropped packet silently desynchronizing the book.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/prod.title: Production Trading Systems
pillars/08-quantitative-development/prod.failure: Missing kill switches and reconciliation drift letting a corrupted position run live.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/prod.title: Production Risk Guards & Kill Switches
pillars/08-quantitative-development/prod.failure: Missing Cancel-on-Disconnect (COD), in-flight socket order race during kill.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/pyth.title: Python Quant Stack
pillars/08-quantitative-development/pyth.failure: Look-ahead in vectorized pandas, silent copy-on-assignment traps, and Python loops in the hot path.

pillars/08-quantitative-development/tick.title: Tick Databases & kdb+/q
pillars/08-quantitative-development/tick.failure: Unsorted timestamps degrading as-of join from O(N) to O(N^2).

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/rough-vola.title: Rough Volatility & Fractional Models
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/rough-vola.failure: Hurst is hard to estimate and drifts; a rough model calibrated on one window misprices the level of the skew out-of-sample, and the simulation is sensitive to the scheme.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/local-stoc.title: Local-Stochastic Volatility (LSV)
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/local-stoc.failure: The leverage function depends on the very marginal it defines, so calibration is a fixed-point that can fail to converge; small errors in the leverage amplify into exotic mispricing.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/deep-hedgi.title: Deep Hedging & BSDEs
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/deep-hedgi.failure: The learned hedge minimises risk under the *model* the paths came from, so model risk is not reduced but hidden; training is seed-unstable and the policy is unauditable.

pillars/03-derivative-pricing/path-signa.title: Path Signatures & Rough Paths
pillars/03-derivative-pricing/path-signa.failure: The signature needs a rough-path lift (and time/lead-lag augmentation) or it is the wrong object for a non-geometric path; truncation order silently discards the information that mattered.

pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/market-micros.title: Market Microstructure Game Theory
pillars/02-algorithmic-hft/market-micros.failure: Equilibrium predictions assume common knowledge and a specified game; real venues have repeated games, anonymity gaps and outages, so the 'equilibrium' spread is a benchmark, not a forecast.

pillars/04-quantitative-risk/climate-and.title: Climate & ESG Risk
pillars/04-quantitative-risk/climate-and.failure: Climate risk is measured in tonnes x price over decades, but portfolios are marked to a return history of a few years; the horizon mismatch and ESG-score disagreement can silently dominate any estimate.

pillars/06-market-making/crypto-and-defi.title: Crypto & DeFi Market Making
pillars/06-market-making/crypto-and-defi.failure: An AMM LP writes a short-gamma payoff for free: fees look positive until an arbitrageur takes the divergence loss, and MEV/sandwiching is the same toxicity the equity pillar describes.

_links_comment: Curated graph edges [source, target, type], by node id. Editorial: which edges to draw is a design choice, so they are listed rather than derived. build_visualizer.py VALIDATES that both endpoints exist, so retiring a node becomes a loud error instead of a silently-dangling edge.
